raw_text: Devastating news from Jharkhand. A CRPF convoy of 209 Battalion was ambushed with an IED in the dense forests of Latehar's Burha Pahar region around 0500 hours today. 4 brave jawans have made the supreme sacrifice. Initial reports suggest the IED was command-detonated followed by automatic weapons fire. Reinforcements have reached the spot. Aerial surveillance deployed. Our hearts go out to the families. Jai Hind. #CRPFAttack #Latehar
clean_text: CRPF 209 Battalion convoy ambushed with command-detonated IED in Latehar Burha Pahar forests at 0500 hours. 4 jawans killed. Followed by automatic weapons fire. Reinforcements and aerial surveillance deployed.
